summary: Validate exact LBVH domain partials for both documented CPU-oracle and production scene launch partitions.
regressions: 4097 colliders across two batches exercise both one-group and two-group partitions, including empty groups; a one-bit corrupted partial is rejected in both.
The existing strict program checker still verifies guards, merged bounds, Morton keys, tree geometry, topology, pair membership and counters.
differences: This explicit workspace policy accompanies 0128 scene launch scaling: the Rust CPU composed oracle still uses one domain workgroup, while production scene launches scale to at most 64. No arbitrary grouping, approximate partials, physics tolerance changes or expected-output edits are accepted.
Full baseline remains stale and unreconciled.
